entities.name: Hubertus von Pilgrim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hubertus von Pilgrim was a German artist who lived and worked in Pullach, near Munich as a sculptor, printmaker and medallist. He has work in the collections of the Brooklyn Museum and Art Institute of Chicago. Von Pilgrim was Vice-Chancellor of the Pour le Mérite from 2009 to 2013.
